# Synthetic fixture for numbered filters and center-frequency shelves.
Preamp: -6 dB
Filter 1: ON LSC Fc 80 Hz Gain 6 dB Q 0.625
Filter 2: ON PK Fc 250 Hz Gain -1.5 dB Q 0.5
Filter 3: ON PK Fc 1000 Hz Gain 2 dB Q 1
Filter 4: ON PK Fc 4000 Hz Gain -4 dB Q 2
Filter 5: ON HSC Fc 10000 Hz Gain 3 dB Q 0.707
Filter 6: ON PK Fc 16000 Hz Gain -2 dB Q 6
